title: Lime Infused Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A smoky and festive Tunisian dish featuring lime and lamb, cooked in a traditional tagine pot with a glassy jelly crust, satvik-friendly and en-croute style.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: boneless and cut into 2 inch pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium heat and add the lamb, cooking until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened into a glassy jelly.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs and lime wedges if desired.
